notes.title: Huge update VALENS
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you for your attention to the VALENS  universe! We are very glad to see the game cause such lively discussion. Your feedback is very important to us! At the moment, we are working on a huge update. 
We are currently engaged in the VALENS  import/transfer to UnrealEngine4.

Soon you will enjoy the long-awaited multiplayer, a greater selection of Hovers, some new worlds, and by popular demand an extra mode of speed racing, survival football and much more. 

All who have already purchased the game will receive a key to the updated version! 

Thank you for your interest and support! In the nearest time, the official game website http://playvalens.com/ will have its own forum where you will be able to share your ideas and wishes. You are welcome to join the VALENS  transformation!
